question_text: What are the differences between "Dhaper Khoi" and 'Shaluk'?

question_text: Do you think that waterlily will disappear from Bangladesh in course of time? Why/why not? Explain in 2/3 sentences.
guide_solution: Yes, in course of time waterlily will disappear because excessive use of chemicals and pesticides in agricultural lands are killing lilies seeds and shaluks beneath the ground.

subject: English
question_text: The following pie-chart shows the amount of time that
stimulus: Robin spends each day on various activities. Now, describe the pre-chart in your own way. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts The pie chart shows the time allocation of Robin's daily activities. From this pie chart it is seen that Robin has to maintain the time allocation for his daily necessary activities. He spends 20% time for his study, and he also need recreation for which he spends 12% time. For playing he spends 5% time. For other types of everyday work, he spends 8% time. He goes to school everyday and stays school and home for which he spends 25% time. He also spends 30% time for sleep. In this way, in this chart we see the time allocation of Robin's daily activities. On the whole, the pie chart represents the time allocation of Robin everyday activities.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 85 — Laksam Pilot High School, Comilla
